selection_basis: The v4 frozen broad recipe passed broad top-10 validation but v5 exposed weak top-rank generalization. v5 was then converted into development data and used to select candidate recipes for a future v6 exact-sequence-excluded holdout.
v6_panel_exclusion_policy: Exclude exact sequences present in known-positive-seed.csv.
Exclude exact sequences present in known-positive-expanded-panel.csv.
Exclude exact sequences present in known-positive-postfreeze-holdout.csv.
Exclude exact sequences present in every AHTPDB-derived training panel used by any candidate recipe.
Exclude sequences used during any v5 recipe selection run.
claim_boundary: No validation claim is attached to these recipes until v6 is curated and run without tuning.
